catalog.name: FERMILGRB - Fermi LAT Second Gamma-Ray Burst Catalog

primary_statistic.name: within_source_centered_energy_time_spearman
primary_statistic.definition: Spearman correlation between trigger-relative arrival time and log10 energy after centering both ranks within each GRB; pool centered ranks across GRBs.

trial_control.secondary_policy: diagnostic_only; maximum absolute statistic calibrated jointly with the same within-GRB permutations

promotion_gate: No anomaly claim from this run. Any residual must survive response/exposure modeling, synthetic injection calibration, trial correction, and an independent frozen replication.
notes: The HEASARC summary table is catalog-level and is not substituted for photon-level data.
No event-level candidate statistic or selected-event count was inspected before this configuration was written; the 1 degree analysis aperture was fixed before selection.
The older v1 registration is preserved but is not reused because its 500-permutation resolution cannot evaluate stringent tails and its distance approximation is not publication quality.
